name: Santa Anita Mall
description: Westfield Santa Anita is a premier enclosed regional shopping destination in Arcadia, California, offering an exceptional mix of fashion, dining, and entertainment experiences. Operated by Westfield, this well-established mall serves the affluent San Gabriel Valley with a curated selection of popular retailers and restaurants. The center provides a modern, climate-controlled shopping environment that draws visitors from throughout the greater Los Angeles area.
demographics: Santa Anita Mall attracts a diverse, affluent demographic from the San Gabriel Valley, with a strong Asian-American presence reflecting the Arcadia area's demographics. The primary trade area consists of middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes averaging $80,000-$120,000, skewing toward households with children and multigenerational families. Visitors typically range from 25-54 years old, with a significant concentration of fashion-conscious shoppers who value both premium brands and dining experiences. The center serves as a regional destination drawing from Pasadena, Monrovia, and throughout the eastern Los Angeles suburbs, with shoppers displaying strong preferences for contemporary fashion, technology retailers, and diverse culinary options.
summary: A well-established Westfield regional mall in the heart of Arcadia serving the San Gabriel Valley with diverse retail, dining, and entertainment options.
